_readme: Product metafield definitions for the house-brand tapware. Namespace `ets` is the store's existing custom namespace (ets.supplier, ets.range, ets.wels_rating ... already live on 1,100+ products). `reuse` lists existing definitions the brand relies on as they are; `create` lists the new ones. Run `python3 scripts/metafield_mutations.py` to regenerate mutations.graphql, then execute it against the Admin API (one mutation document per block).

reuse.name: WELS registration
reuse.note: WELS registration number, e.g. T12345. Mandatory for tapware.

reuse.name: WELS rating
reuse.note: Text, '5 Star' (the pipeline normalises to '<n> Star'). Used by the theme, product schema and the Search & Discovery filter. Mandatory for tapware.

reuse.name: Warranty
reuse.note: Legacy free text on older products. New products use warranty_years; the theme shows whichever is set.

reuse.name: Cartridge
reuse.note: Legacy '35mm' text on MELA products. New products use cartridge_brand + cartridge_size_mm.

reuse.name: Range
reuse.note: Suite / range name, e.g. 'Aria'. Drives the suite collection handle <vendor>-<range>.

reuse.name: Supplier
reuse.note: Internal only (pinned). Never rendered by the theme.

reuse.name: Lead Time
reuse.note: Internal/customer lead time text. Leave blank on house-brand products (never say stock is ordered on demand).

create.name: WaterMark licence number
create.description: WaterMark licence number (WMKA/WMK... or certifier reference). Required before a plumbing product can be published.

create.name: WaterMark certifier
create.description: Conformity assessment body that issued the WaterMark licence, e.g. SAI Global, IAPMO R&T Oceana, Global-Mark.

create.name: Finish
create.description: Finishes the product is offered in. Spelling follows the store's existing Finish option values.

create.name: Cartridge brand
create.description: Ceramic disc cartridge maker, e.g. Sedal, Kerox, Flühs.

create.name: Max working pressure (kPa)
create.description: Maximum working pressure in kPa (AS/NZS 3500 limits new installations to 500 kPa).

create.name: Installation type
create.description: Deck mounted, Wall mounted, Hob mounted, Floor mounted, Ceiling mounted, In-wall.

create.name: Spout projection (mm)
create.description: Spout reach from the wall or deck, mm.

create.name: Spout height (mm)
create.description: Height of the spout outlet above the deck or basin, mm.

create.name: Warranty (years)
create.description: Manufacturer warranty in years. The theme shows this when the legacy warranty text is empty.

create.name: Specification sheet
create.description: PDF spec sheet shown under Downloads on the product page.

create.name: Installation guide
create.description: PDF installation guide shown under Downloads on the product page.

publish_gate._note: A product may only be ACTIVE when every one of these is non-empty. Enforced by scripts/import_supplier.py; the theme only hides badges when they are missing.
